ed.template_replace_confirm: Replace the current blocks with the template?\n\nOK = replace, Cancel = add the template after the current blocks.
ed.featured_hint: Show this article as featured on the website homepage.
ed.tags_placeholder: Type a tag and press Enter
ed.tags_hint: Any text, including long keywords and phrases. Press Enter to add; suggestions come from tags used before.
ed.types_hint: Topic, Article and Host Journal are built in. Add your own (e.g. Outfit Guide); each article has one type, which can be shown on the website.
ed.templates_empty: No templates yet. Use "Save as New Template" in the editor.
ed.template_delete_confirm: Delete this template? Articles made from it are not affected.

content.title: Style content
content.intro: Topics, articles and host journals (ralulu.com/style/...). Each page has its own SEO fields.
content.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Do not change after publishing.
content.label: Category label
content.body_hint: Build the article from blocks. Use the arrows to move a block, and Preview to see how it looks on the website.
content.add_product: Add product by ID or search
content.lang_hint: One article = one language. Pick it once; the article is published under a URL starting with it.

editor.pick_product_hint: Pick a product to insert as a card at the cursor.
editor.empty_article: This article has no content yet. Add the first block:
editor.toc_title: Table of contents (made from the H2 headings)
editor.toc_needs_two: shown on the website from 2 headings
editor.link_invalid: Only http(s), mailto, tel or site links (starting with /) are allowed.
editor.tags_placeholder: Tags, separated by commas or spaces

logo.title: Website logo
logo.hint: Shown in the website header. PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 2 MB; a transparent PNG about 400 px wide works best. A saved logo is used on the website straight away.
logo.none: No logo - the text ralulu is shown
logo.bad_type: Use a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
logo.too_big: The logo must be 2 MB or smaller.
logo.failed: Could not save the logo. Please try again.

theme.title: Theme & Appearance
theme.intro: Colours of the whole website are design tokens. Changes show here live; nothing goes live until you publish.
theme.blocked: Cannot publish: fix {{n}} contrast issue(s) first
theme.published: Published. The website now uses this theme.

roles_desc.primary: Main buttons, selected states, CS button

theme.publish_failed: Publish failed, the live site keeps the previous version

product.title: Website
product.intro: What the customer website shows for this product.
product.live_code_hint: The code the host says on live, e.g. A12 (letters/numbers).

live.title: Global LIVE Settings
live.intro: Set the LIVE hours once. Hosts follow the shift and location they have in Host Management; the website shows who is LIVE and who is next automatically. All times are Taiwan time (UTC+8).
live.load_failed: Could not load the LIVE settings.
live.save_failed: Could not save. Please try again.
live.shifts_hint: Default LIVE hours of each shift. Every host on a shift follows these hours. Evening is empty until you set its hours.
live.shift_empty: No hours yet - hosts on this shift are not shown as LIVE.
live.locations_hint: Working days are set per location and apply to every host of that location. Add extra days off for holidays or closures.
live.hosts_hint: Name, location and shift come from Host Management. Paste the TikTok LIVE link of each host here; it can be changed at any time. Start LIVE / End LIVE work at any time and never change the schedule.
live.end_confirm: End the current LIVE of {{name}}? The next scheduled session starts as usual.
live.start_confirm: Start LIVE for {{name}} now? The host shows as LIVE immediately and stays LIVE until you press End LIVE (or after 12 hours). The host's schedule does not change.
live.manual_hint: Started manually; ends with End LIVE or automatically after 12 hours

banners.title: Homepage banners
banners.intro: Banners rotate automatically on the homepage and can be swiped. Recommended size {{size}} px (8:3); on phones the left and right edges (about 25% each) may be cropped, so keep text and faces in the middle. Without any active banner the default hero is shown.
banners.link: Link (optional): a page like /products?sort=newest or an external https:// address
banners.saved: Banners saved. The website updates within about a minute.

categories_layout.title: Category page layout
categories_layout.intro: Arrange the category page in sections of five cards. Empty slots and categories without products are hidden on the website. Without any section the website arranges all categories automatically.
categories_layout.none: No custom layout yet: the website arranges the categories automatically. Add a section to take control.
categories_layout.saved: Category layout saved. The website updates within about a minute.

page_members.title: Members
page_members.intro: Website accounts (login by WhatsApp or email), their wallet and referrals.
page_members.search: Search name / phone / email / referral code
page_members.name: Name
page_members.rewards_intro: Defaults for balance, points, referral and coupons. Changes apply to new activity only.
page_members.refund_credit_bonus_pct: Bonus when a refund becomes balance (%)

page_shipping_wb.title: Shipping Workbench
page_shipping_wb.cross_batch_desc: Upload shipping records without opening the original batch. Each row is matched across all batches by the identifiers it carries; rows that cannot be matched reliably are flagged, never guessed.
page_shipping_wb.cross_platform_hint: 7-ELEVEN import result, 7-ELEVEN order export or FamilyMart order export. The file type is detected automatically.
page_shipping_wb.cross_3pl_hint: May contain orders from several providers and dates.
page_shipping_wb.cross_delivery_hint: Exported from one shipping platform at a time; overlapping data is safe to import again.
page_shipping_wb.alert_settings_desc: Show a warning when an order stays in a status longer than this. It is only a reminder; nothing changes automatically.
page_shipping_wb.create_batch_desc: Only orders created before today (Taiwan time) with enough physical stock for the whole order can be batched. Creating a batch reserves the stock; the Excel file is downloaded afterwards from the batch.
page_shipping_wb.today_excluded: {{count}} order(s) created today are not eligible yet.
page_shipping_wb.insufficient_note: These orders cannot be fully covered by physical stock. They become eligible automatically once stock arrives.
page_shipping_wb.problem_note: Fix the order information (customer service) before these can be batched.
page_shipping_wb.problem_name_long: Recipient name is longer than 10 characters (5 Chinese)
page_shipping_wb.problem_order_no: Order number is invalid for this carrier
page_shipping_wb.problem_store: Pickup store code must be 6 digits
page_shipping_wb.problem_store_unknown: Pickup store code was not found in the store directory
page_shipping_wb.missing_shipping_warning: {{count}} order(s) are missing a shipping number. Import the platform order export again once it is available.
page_shipping_wb.verif_pending_verification_hint: Not in the uploaded platform results. Verify on the platform before retrying — never assumed failed.
page_shipping_wb.format_pending: Waiting for the file format — this upload will be enabled once the format is confirmed.
page_shipping_wb.err_unrecognised: This file was not recognised as a supported shipping file.
page_shipping_wb.err_empty: The file contains no order rows.
page_shipping_wb.err_wrong_file: This looks like another file type: {{kind}}. Use the matching upload area.
page_shipping_wb.import_repeat: This exact file was imported before. Nothing was duplicated.
page_shipping_wb.s1_hint: Download the Excel file and upload it to the shipping platform to create the shipping orders.
page_shipping_wb.duplicate_warning: Upload this file to the platform only ONCE. Uploading it twice creates duplicate shipping orders. Downloading it again later is safe — it never changes any order.
page_shipping_wb.confirm_redownload: This file was already downloaded. Re-downloading is safe, but do NOT upload it to the platform again if it was already uploaded. Continue?
page_shipping_wb.nothing_to_export: There are no orders to export.
page_shipping_wb.s2_hint: Steps to complete outside the ERP. No upload is needed in this section.
page_shipping_wb.instr_711_1: Download the Excel file from Section 01.
page_shipping_wb.instr_711_3: Upload the file to create the shipping orders.
page_shipping_wb.instr_711_5: Download the import result file and the official order export.
page_shipping_wb.instr_711_6: Return to Section 03 and upload each file in its own area.
page_shipping_wb.instr_fm_1: Download the Excel file from Section 01.
page_shipping_wb.instr_fm_2: Open the FamilyMart 好賣+ platform and upload the file.
page_shipping_wb.instr_fm_3: If the platform stops at an error, note the failing row — orders before it were already created. Do not upload those again.
page_shipping_wb.instr_fm_4: Obtain the shipping numbers on the platform, then export the orders.
page_shipping_wb.instr_fm_5: Return to Section 03 and upload the export.
page_shipping_wb.instr_hct_1: Download the Excel file from Section 01.
page_shipping_wb.instr_hct_2: Upload the file to the HCT platform.
page_shipping_wb.instr_hct_3: Obtain the shipping numbers from HCT.
page_shipping_wb.instr_hct_4: Export the corresponding data from HCT.
page_shipping_wb.instr_hct_5: Return to Section 03 and upload it.
page_shipping_wb.s3_hint_cvs_711: Upload the two 7-ELEVEN files, each in its own area. Re-uploading a file is safe.
page_shipping_wb.s3_hint_cvs_familymart: Upload the FamilyMart order export (with order and shipping numbers). Re-uploading is safe.
page_shipping_wb.s3_hint_courier: Upload the HCT result file with the shipping numbers.
page_shipping_wb.upload_a_title: Upload A — 訂單匯入結果 (Order Import Results)
page_shipping_wb.upload_a_hint: The validation result from 7-ELEVEN. Shows success or the original error per order.
page_shipping_wb.upload_b_title: Upload B — 7-ELEVEN 訂單匯出 (Official Order Export)
page_shipping_wb.upload_b_hint: The order export downloaded from 7-ELEVEN. Saves the platform order number (CM…) and shipping number (G…). The 訂單匯入 sheet is read.
page_shipping_wb.upload_fm_hint: Matched by 賣場名稱 (our order number); saves 訂單編號 and 寄件編號.
page_shipping_wb.upload_hct_hint: Matched by our order number; saves the HCT shipping number.
page_shipping_wb.s4_hint: Only verified orders are included. Orders already sent to the 3PL are never exported again.
page_shipping_wb.packing_placeholder: The 3PL packing format is not confirmed yet. This download uses the existing Packing Label layout as a placeholder.
page_shipping_wb.s5_hint: An order becomes Shipped only when the 3PL confirms actual shipment — never from exporting documents.
page_shipping_wb.s5_upload_hint: Stock is deducted once per order, however often the file is imported.
page_shipping_wb.s6_hint: Updates orders from delivery / pickup status files. Older records never overwrite newer statuses; stock is never touched.
page_shipping_wb.s6_upload_hint: Can include orders from several batches of this provider.
page_shipping_wb.s7_hint: Failed orders stay in this batch until resolved. They never block the other orders.
page_shipping_wb.likely_failing: Likely the row that stopped the import — orders after it were skipped.
page_shipping_wb.confirm_not_created: Confirm this order was NOT created on the platform? It will then be included in the retry file.
page_shipping_wb.retry_download_hint: Only orders confirmed as failed. Orders already created are never included.
page_shipping_wb.retry_upload_hint: Upload the new result file(s) after retrying. Successful orders are matched in this same batch.
page_shipping_wb.issue_ready_too_long: Ready to Ship for too long
page_shipping_wb.issue_import_identifier_conflict: Identifier differs from the stored one
page_shipping_wb.issue_import_not_in_batch: Order is not in any batch
page_shipping_wb.issue_import_not_ready: Shipment reported before the order was ready
page_shipping_wb.confirm_all_not_created: Confirm all {{count}} orders were NOT created on the platform? They will all be included in the retry file.

keep_date.hint_shipping: Exportable in the Shipping Workbench 1 day before this date.
keep_date.hint_delivery: Ship date is 3 days before; exportable in the Shipping Workbench 4 days before this date.

page_opening_inventory.title: Initial Inventory Setup (FIFO go-live)
page_opening_inventory.intro: Upload the verified on-hand quantity and approved RMB unit cost of every SKU. Approving the file creates the opening FIFO cost layers and switches FIFO costing on. Past orders are not changed.
page_opening_inventory.columns_hint: Columns: sku, qty, unit_cost_rmb, exchange_rate (empty rate = default rate).
page_opening_inventory.approve_confirm: Approve this file? Its quantities and costs become the opening FIFO layers.
page_opening_inventory.fix_errors_hint: Some lines have problems - fix the file and upload it again.
page_opening_inventory.diff_hint: Differs from the system's Actual stock

page_website_analytics.title: Website Analytics
page_website_analytics.intro: Visitors and page views of the customer website, from Google Analytics 4.
page_website_analytics.not_connected: Google Analytics is not connected yet
page_website_analytics.not_connected_hint: Ask the developer to set these environment variables on the server (property id, service account key with Viewer access to the GA4 property, and the measurement id for the website tag). Numbers appear here after that; visits are only counted from the moment the tag is live.
page_website_analytics.unavailable: Google Analytics did not answer (permission, quota or wrong property). Try again in a few minutes.
